description:
Be visionary 
 
 Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research. ​ 
 
 We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.
   
 Job Description 
   
 About the Team and Role 
 We are seeking a dedicated Platform Engineer with five+ years’ experience to join our Platform Engineering group at the Huntsville Operations Support Center (HOSC). Our team is responsible for building, managing, and modernizing critical systems infrastructure. We provide cutting-edge Kubernetes containerization and virtualization solutions designed to support both modern architecture and legacy systems.
 
 In this role, you will be at the forefront of our infrastructure modernization efforts, ensuring our platforms are scalable, secure, and highly available. You will work heavily with Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, and automation tools to empower developers and support critical operations—including emerging in-house AI initiatives.
 
 This is a terrific opportunity to apply your technical skills to NASA's historic efforts, including sustaining operations on the International Space Station (ISS) and powering the Artemis program—which is sending humans back to the Moon and laying the foundation for Mars exploration. Be part of the team in Huntsville, Alabama—the Rocket City—driving advancements in human spaceflight and helping shape the future of exploration.
 
 Core Responsibilities 
 Infrastructure Management:  Build, deploy, and manage Kubernetes infrastructure across multiple distributions, including OpenShift, Charm Kubernetes, and AWS EKS/OpenShift.
 GitOps & CI/CD:  Architect and build Kubernetes solutions using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) techniques, utilizing ArgoCD and Argo Workflows for continuous delivery and GitLab for CI/CD pipelines.
 Platform Tooling:  Manage, maintain, and optimize core infrastructure tools such as GitLab, Red Hat Satellite, and Prometheus/Grafana to support both modern and legacy environments.
 Troubleshooting & Support:  Act as an escalation point to troubleshoot complex, Kubernetes-based issues and provide operational support for legacy Linux and Windows virtualization solutions.
 Architectural Guidance:  Design and provide robust Kubernetes-based architectural solutions as project requirements evolve.
 AI Infrastructure Support:  Support and maintain infrastructure for in-house Artificial Intelligence efforts based on Red Hat AI on OpenShift and Poolside.ai.
 
 Required Qualifications & Skills 
 Education:  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent comparable experience).
 Kubernetes Expertise:  Proven hands-on experience with Kubernetes distributions, specifically OpenShift, Charm Kubernetes, EKS and OpenShift in AWS GovCloud.
 Operating Systems:  Strong administration skills in Linux environments (Red Hat/RHEL, Ubuntu, Debian, Windows).
 CLI Proficiency:  Fluent in essential command-line tools including  oc ,  kubectl ,  virtctl , and standard Linux CLI utilities.
 Cloud Platforms:  Experience with AWS Cloud infrastructure.
 GitOps & Automation:  Strong experience with GitOps methodologies using Visual Studio Code, GitLab, and ArgoCD. Proficiency in configuration management using Ansible.
 Virtualization:  Experience with OpenShift Virtualization.
 Observability & Logging:  Hands-on experience deploying and managing Prometheus/Grafana, Loki logging stacks, and Splunk (log collection and analysis).
 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 While not required, experience in any of the following areas will make your application stand out:
 Advanced Kubernetes & Containers:  Advanced Cluster Management (ACM), Advanced Cluster Security (ACS), Red Hat CoreOS administration, LXC containers, and LXD ecosystems.
 Red Hat Virtual Machine Migration tool
 Canonical Tooling:  Juju and Charm experience.
 Infrastructure as Code:  Terraform, Helm, and Kustomize
 Networking & Ingress:  Traefik, MetalLB, Multicast Networking, NMSTATE, Multus, and HAProxy router sharding.
 Hypervisors & Infrastructure:  Proxmox administration/design, Broadcom administration, and AWS GovCloud.
 Messaging & Event Streaming:  Kafka and NATS (microservices messaging).
 Identity & Security:  PIV-M authentication, OIDC, KeyCloak, and LDAP integrations.
 AI GPU and model tuning: fine-tuning GPUs on AI worker nodes
 AI Platforms:  Familiarity with Red Hat AI, Poolside.ai, GPU utilization and tuning, and elements of an AI stack (inference, modeling, Harness implementation, User interfaces)
 
 Clearance & Eligibility Requirements 
 Clearance:  Must be eligible and able to successfully obtain a  NASA Position of Trust .
 
 
 #TBE
   
 Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.
 
 Teledyne is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other characteristic or non-merit based factor made unlawful by federal, state, or local laws. ​
